archimate:ValueStream.name: 5. Operational security
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
The service needs to be operated and managed securely in order to impede, detect or prevent attacks. It will achieve this through a combination of effective vulnerability management, protective monitoring, configuration & change management, and incident management.
https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/collection/cloud/the-cloud-security-principles/principle-5-operational-security
